we propose a novel method for improving the transferability of policies learned in simulation to real robots.
we propose a method for improving transferability of policies in reinforcement learning by learning a summary of diverse behaviors from the simulator.

it is possible to train policies on a small set of representative configurations, which can be sampled efficiently.
